name: Team Krushi
description: Welcome to Team Krushi! We are a dynamic community of students passionate about our field. Join us to explore, learn, and grow through our various activities and projects.

events.name: Team Krushi Project Showcase
events.detail: Team KRUSHI brings together engineering students to design and prototype field-ready agri-tech solutions that improve productivity, safety, and affordability. Using the TORQUE framework, the club conducts hands-on development, field testing, and farmer collaboration. With two patents to its name, Team KRUSHI welcomes partnerships with industry, researchers, and farming communities to scale and deploy its innovations. A demonstration of the tractor module presenting project origin, design methodology, and system architecture, followed by a live operational demo and a brief interactive question-and-answer session. Participants will form small teams to analyse a real farmer’s problem, generate rapid solution concepts under mentor supervision, and deliver a concise, feasibility-focused pitch. A structured, interactive quiz assessing understanding of the showcased project and core agri-tech principles; each question will be accompanied by a short explanatory discussion and practical demonstration. A keynote examining the lifecycle of agri- tech innovations — from needs assessment through prototyping and deployment — illustrated with case studies and actionable guidance, concluding with an invitation to join Team Krushi.
